verdict.rationale: Customer.io's docs name an SDK as a primary way to send data in, alongside the Pipelines API. A dedicated SDK docs page covers mobile identification, push, and in-app messaging. A Postman collection and a live OpenAPI spec back up building against its APIs. Missing for 10: an enumerated list of supported SDK languages and platforms, documented server-side SDK coverage of the App and Transactional APIs, SDK versioning and maintenance details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
